{'Translation': "While using a computer on the desktop isn't a new feature for Claude, the ability to run it in the background is certainly a welcome upgrade.", 'Reference': '雖然Claude喺桌面版使用電腦並唔係新功能，但能夠喺背景運行確實係一個唔錯嘅升級。'}

{'Translation': 'Anthropic announced today that the background computer use feature for Claude Code is now available, currently limited to Pro and Max users on macOS.', 'Reference': 'Anthropic今日宣布，Claude Code嘅背景電腦使用功能現已推出，暫時只支援macOS系統嘅Pro同Max用戶。'}

{'Translation': "OpenAI's Codex (now integrated into ChatGPT) earlier brought background computer use to the Mac. It's good to see Anthropic's Claude Mac app improving its version.", 'Reference': 'OpenAI嘅Codex（現已整合至ChatGPT）較早前已將背景電腦使用功能帶到Mac。能夠見到Anthropic嘅Claude Mac應用程式改進佢哋嘅版本，係一件好事。'}

{'Translation': "When AI-powered computer use means handing over your mouse control to an agent, it's not that practical. But when it runs in the background, it becomes a significant multitasking breakthrough on the Mac.", 'Reference': '當AI驅動嘅電腦使用功能意味着要將你嘅滑鼠操控權交畀代理，咁就冇咁實用。但當佢喺背景運行嘅時候，就成為Mac上一個重大嘅多工處理突破。'}

{'Translation': 'Learn more about computer use features in Claude for Code and Cowork.', 'Reference': '了解更多關於Claude喺Code同Cowork嘅電腦使用功能。'}

{'Translation': 'Get the most out of your Apple products', 'Reference': '充分發揮你嘅Apple產品功能'}
